name: Toast
description: A brief notification in the corner that confirms an action or reports progress.

props.name: action
props.description: One follow-up action, such as Undo.

props.name: variant
props.description: Danger adds an alert icon and color. Default neutral.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner for work in progress.

props.name: duration
props.description: Auto-dismiss delay in ms, paused while hovered or focused. Infinity keeps it. Default 5000.

props.name: useToasts()
props.description: State for a ToastViewport, which renders them in the corner.

a11y: The viewport is a labelled region with aria-live="polite", present before any toast, so new toasts are announced.
Timers pause while a toast is hovered or focused; the dismiss button has an accessible name.
